description: The page a subscriber reaches from the campaign email, once member quotes have been collected: the merge tag supplies a first name so the headline reads 'Ben, let's go further together', and the testimonials section renders its populated state in real page context. Paired with 'Public Visitor', which holds the production-today state — generic headline, no quotes yet — so the two differ by both personalization and the testimonials band rather than being the same page twice.
